notes.title: Update 6.4.2
notes.notes:
Features:

 Added editing templates in settings
 Added splitting audio track at specfic points and at regular intervals
 Added a lot of tooltops to improve accessability of the application


Bug-fixes:

 Fixed quality setting did not have effect until restart
 Fixed locking posters until program exits
 A lot of UI fixes and improvements



Other

 Upgraded Java to version 21 LTS
 Upgraded FFMPEG to version 7.0.1
 Upgraded multiple java libraries

notes.title: Release 6.0.0
notes.notes:
New Version 6.0.0



 Replaced configuration text files with embedded database, which should positively impact on stability.
 Added different options for forcing re-enccoding: Always - re-encode everything, Lazy - no re-encoding for compatible codecs, i.e. alac->aac, vorbis->opus, Auto - re-encode only if codec is different.
 Implemented resulting file optimisation - applied at the very end and respect all embed images.
 Fixed bug with creating sub-tracks for single source file
 Fixed bug with extracting only 1 image from source file, now all artworks are extracted
 Added progress for adding artwork and optimising resulting file.
 Fixed issue with splitting and combining chapters and parts.
 Changed the way presets works - now you need to explicitly save preset instead of confusing autosaving. Also preset now includes all settings on quality tab.
 Fixed bug with genres saving
 Big number of minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update to version 5.5.25
notes.notes:
- Upgraded to FFMpeg 4.4
- Upgraded to OpenJDK 16.0.2
- Fixed result chapters have slightly wrong duration on some input files
- Fixed artwork from previous conversion being added to next conversation if artwork scan process did not complete on time
- Fixed missing chapters split from context menu
- Fixed output split by chapters, which was temporary broken
- Fixed book number was staying from previous conversion
- Added feature to remove artwork and "exactly same" artwork won't be added again if found during current scan.
- Some rework to architecture to allow artwork fix
